Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT A. Francisco Gold Condominium II Bldg, EDSA corner Mapagmahal St., Diliman, Quezon City LEGAL SERVICE DILG OPINION NO. VICE MAYOR DANTE G. ZAMORA Municipality of Jimalalud Province of Negros Oriental Dear Vice-Mayor Zamora: 2010 This pertains to your Indorsement dated 23 March 2010 requesting this level's further opinion on whether the appointment of one Shinette S. Bungcasan by Governor Emilio C. Macias, Negros Oriental, to fill in the vacancy in the Sangguniang Bayan of Jimalalud, Negros Oriental, has complied with the basic requirements of Section 45 (b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) considering that Ms. Bungcasan's nomination and certificate of membership was signed only by the Provincial Chairman of the political party where she belonged. As stated in your 05 March 2010 letter addressed to our DILG-Provincial Director, which was attached to the aforesaid Indorsement, there was a vacancy in the Sangguniang Bayan of the Municipality of Jimalalud, Negros Oriental created -by the death of Guerrilleto B. Sarabia. Thereafter, Governor Macias appointed Ms. Bungcasan, daughter of the late Mr. Sarabia and a member of the same political party, Lakas-CMD Party where Mr. Sarabia belonged, upon her nomination and certification by the said political patty. However, Ms. Bungcasan's certification appears to have been signed by the party's Provincial Chairman, and in your view, this is not in consonance with the basic requirements on nomination and certification under Section 45(b) of the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) which states: "SECTION 45. Permanent Vacancies in Sanggunian. — (a) xxx the (b) Except for the sangguniang baangay, only the nominee of the political party under which the sanggunian member concerned had been elected and whose elevation by the position next higher in rank created the last vacancy in the sanggunian shall be appointed in the manner hereinabove provided. The appointee shall come from the same political party as that of the sanggunian member who caused the vacancy and shall serve the unexpired term of the vacant office. In the appointment herein mentioned. a nomination and a certificate of membership Of the appointee from the highest official of the political party concerned are conditions sine qua non, and anv appointment without such nomination and certification shall be null and void ab initio and shall be a ground for administrative action against the official responsible therefor." (Emphasis Supplied)

-2- In response thereto, please be informed that since the appointment of Ms. Bungcasan has already been completed, any question as to its non-compliance with the requirements provided under the Local Government Code of 1991 (RA 7160) is already a justiciable issue. This Department is bereft of any authority to declare such appointment invalid, only our courts of justice can make such declaration upon proper legal action. Hence, we find the opinion or suggestion of DILG Region VII Director Pedro Noval who viewed that 'the appointment issued by Governor Emilio Macias is accorded with the presumption of regularity', in consonance with the legal presumption that "public officials have in their favor, a presumption of regularity in the performance of their duties", to be in order. This principle of giving Ms. Bungcasan's appointment such status is not really for her protection but that of the transacting public who are expected and supposed to rely on her authority as represented to the public. Thank you very much and we hope that we addressed your concern with clarity. Very truly yours, B.D UEIV ATTY. JE Director III Copy Furnished: Regional Director PEDRO m NOVAL DILG-Regjon vll Negros Oriental Jofralito L Lorico Provincial Director DILG Provincial Operations Office Sudlon, Lahug, Cebu City Ls:55/17
